shortDescription: On-chain data showed that USDC Treasury minted 250 million USDC on the Solana network at 5:42 and again at 11:04 Beijing time today, for a total of 500 million USDC across two issuances. According to ChainCatcher, the two mints were recorded on-chain on the Solana network today.

title: USDC Treasury Mints 500 Million USDC on Solana in Two Transactions
